observations: Photo 0 shows a used car engine with a black plastic engine cover.
The cover has 'GDI' printed on it.
The engine appears dirty and used, with visible wear and some red paint on the top.
A large black air intake hose is attached to the engine.
The engine is sitting on a concrete surface in what looks like a workshop or yard.
A watermark 'IWAKOJUJI EZE' is visible across the center of the image.

risks.risk: The engine may not be in good mechanical condition.
risks.proof: A video of the engine running or a photo of the engine bay showing the cooling system.

risks.risk: The engine may be a different brand or model than the seller claims.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine block with the manufacturer's identification plate.

risks.risk: The air intake hose may be damaged or leaking.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the hose and a video of it being tested for leaks.

proof_requests: Photo of the engine identification plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine bay showing the cooling system.
Photo of the air intake hose.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
